mapper.select: SELECT c.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.price AS unit_price, c.quantity, p.price * c.quantity AS line_total FROM cart_items c JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id
SELECT quantity FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_items (user_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
